'''Querit''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a daughter, [[Ona Querit]], who was seduced by the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] criminal [[Kaliyo Djannis]]; Ona ran away from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with Djannis, and Querit believed her to have been kidnapped, though he did not cut off her access to her accounts. Djannis eventually left the senator's daughter on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]], breaking her heart and leading her to become a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].
